title: RoboRender · 多视角视频生成模型结构图

description.zh: 官方真实模型结构图：上一帧、视频、机器人掩码、深度和语言条件进入联合多视角潜空间，经 Diffusion Transformer 生成不同相机视角。与论文 Teaser 为不同素材。
description.en: Authentic model-architecture figure from the official RoboRender project, showing prior-frame, video, robot-mask, depth and text conditioning, joint multi-view latents, and diffusion decoding. Not its teaser.

alt.en: RoboRender official multiview video-generation model diagram with previous frame, video, robot mask, depth and text conditioning

label.zh: 官方真实图 · CC BY 4.0 · 原样收录

zh: 需要研究多视角机器人视频生成的模块排布与证据标注
需要参考深度、机器人掩码、文本和上一帧共同条件化的模型示意图
en: Studying module layout and explanatory labels for multi-view robot video generation
Designing a diagram that combines depth, robot masks, text and previous-frame conditions

zh: 将多模态输入分组对齐到对应视角，并保留明确标签
用通道/Token 的中间表示桥接条件信号与生成核心
在右侧显示每个视角的输出，直观说明多视角耦合机制
en: Align heterogeneous inputs by camera view and label them explicitly
Connect conditioning signals to generation via an intermediate token representation
Show per-camera outputs on the right to communicate multi-view coupling

zh: 不要把此模型结构图标记为 RoboRender 的论文 Teaser 或 Figure 1
即使 CC BY 允许再分发，也必须保留作者、出处、许可和改动说明
论文图可作为设计参考，但不能无说明地挪用其他研究的实证内容
en: Do not present the model diagram as RoboRender's teaser or Figure 1
Keep authors, source, license and modification status when redistributing
Do not reuse the original research evidence as if it were your own results
